creative_direction.name: Board-formed Sea Wall Ledger
creative_direction.brief: A brutalist coast after mist: board-formed concrete wall with horizontal formwork seams and round tie marks meets a continuous honed concrete ground at a horizon aligned exactly with the true base line, cool diffuse sea-fog light keeping every tone matte. The cutout stands right of centre on that ground, its measured contact shadow settling into the pale cement, while the left wall stays calm for a wrapped Times column: brand at column head, the name across two tall serif lines, the eau de toilette line and a short slate rule closing the column like a tide gauge mark. Vertical overlap with the shoulder but wide horizontal clearance keeps the two-column editorial grid honest; cold cement matte against luminous ocean-blue glass is the whole temperature story.
creative_direction.material: board-formed concrete wall with continuous honed concrete ground
creative_direction.lighting: cool diffuse overcast sea-fog daylight, soft frontal with no hard shadows, matching the baked studio light
